recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有大型泡沫細胞（foam cell），胞質充滿大小均一的清亮小空泡、呈肥皂泡狀，並散在細小藍色顆粒，細胞核小而圓，符合 Niemann-Pick 病的脂質堆積巨噬細胞。
features: Large histiocyte(s) many times the size of surrounding cells, with abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm filled with numerous small, fairly uniform clear vacuoles giving a foamy, soap-bubble appearance
Scattered fine blue-staining granules among the vacuoles
Small round nuclei compressed within the foamy cytoplasm; overlapping cells obscure some detail
Background of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large foamy histiocyte, possibly two overlapping cells, with abundant cytoplasm distended by numerous small uniform clear vacuoles and scattered fine blue granules. The nuclei are small and round, and overlapping hematopoietic cells partly obscure the cell outline. The background shows maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of a lysosomal storage disorder; in an infant with developmental delay and hepatosplenomegaly and deficient enzyme activity, this supports Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled tissue paper cytoplasm with striations rather than uniform bubbly vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain prominent blue-green ceroid granules on Giemsa, whereas Niemann-Pick cells are predominantly foamy with only scant blue granules.
Reactive foamy macrophages are scattered and accompany lipid disorders or cell turnover without infantile neurologic disease and deficient acid sphingomyelinase.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive with atypical nuclei and are keratin positive, unlike bland CD68-positive foam cells.
